initial_description:
Here is a detailed description of an illustrative diagram for the PaperBanana framework:

**1. Overall Layout:**

The diagram will flow from left to right, representing the sequential progression of the PaperBanana framework. It will be divided into two main horizontal sections: "Phase 1 - Linear Planning" and "Phase 2 - Iterative Refinement." Within each phase, components will be arranged linearly, with arrows indicating the flow of information and processes.

**2. Components:**

*   **Input Section (Far Left):**
    *   **"Methodology Section (S)"**: A rectangular box.
    *   **"Figure Caption (C)"**: A rectangular box, positioned below and slightly to the right of "Methodology Section (S)".

*   **Phase 1 - Linear Planning (Left to Right):**
    *   **"Retriever Agent"**: A rectangular box.
    *   **"Planner Agent"**: A rectangular box, positioned to the right of "Retriever Agent".
    *   **"Stylist Agent"**: A rectangular box, positioned to the right of "Planner Agent".
    *   **"Curated Set of High-Quality Diagrams"**: A small, distinct visual element (e.g., a stack of stylized document icons or a small gallery icon) positioned above and slightly to the left of the "Retriever Agent".

*   **Phase 2 - Iterative Refinement (Left to Right):**
    *   **"Visualizer Agent"**: A rectangular box, positioned below and to the right of the "Stylist Agent", initiating Phase 2.
    *   **"Critic Agent"**: A rectangular box, positioned to the right of the "Visualizer Agent".
    *   **"Text-to-Image Generation Model"**: A smaller, distinct visual element (e.g., a cloud icon with an image silhouette inside) positioned within or closely associated with the "Visualizer Agent".

*   **Output Section (Far Right):**
    *   **"Publication-Quality Academic Illustration"**: A large, prominent rectangular box or a stylized image frame icon.

**3. Connections:**

*   An arrow originates from "Methodology Section (S)" and points to the "Retriever Agent", labeled **"Input S"**.
*   An arrow originates from "Figure Caption (C)" and points to the "Planner Agent", labeled **"Input C"**.
*   An arrow originates from the "Curated Set of High-Quality Diagrams" and points to the "Retriever Agent", labeled **"Reference Examples"**.
*   An arrow originates from the "Retriever Agent" and points to the "Planner Agent", labeled **"Top-10 References"**.
*   An arrow originates from the "Planner Agent" and points to the "Stylist Agent", labeled **"Textual Description (P)"**.
*   An arrow originates from the "Stylist Agent" and points to the "Visualizer Agent", labeled **"Refined Description (P*)"**.
*   An arrow originates from the "Visualizer Agent" and points to the "Critic Agent", labeled **"Rendered Image"**.
*   An arrow originates from the "Critic Agent" and points back to the "Visualizer Agent", labeled **"Revision Feedback"**. This arrow will be slightly thicker and potentially dashed to indicate the iterative nature.
*   A loop is formed by the arrow from "Critic Agent" to "Visualizer Agent" and the arrow from "Visualizer Agent" to "Critic Agent". This loop will be visually distinct, perhaps enclosed in a rounded rectangle with a label like **"Iterative Refinement (up to 3x)"**.
*   An arrow originates from the "Critic Agent" (after satisfactory refinement) and points to the "Publication-Quality Academic Illustration", labeled **"Final Illustration"**.

**4. Groupings:**

*   **Phase 1 Section:** A light, warm peach colored rectangular background will encompass the "Retriever Agent", "Planner Agent", and "Stylist Agent", with a subtle dashed border. The label "Phase 1 - Linear Planning" will be placed prominently above this section.
*   **Phase 2 Section:** A light, soft sky blue colored rectangular background will encompass the "Visualizer Agent" and "Critic Agent". The label "Phase 2 - Iterative Refinement" will be placed prominently above this section.
*   The input components ("Methodology Section (S)", "Figure Caption (C)", "Curated Set of High-Quality Diagrams") will be grouped together on the far left, perhaps within a very light grey outline or simply aligned.
*   The output component ("Publication-Quality Academic Illustration") will be on the far right, clearly separated.

**5. Labels and Annotations:**

*   All component boxes will have their exact labels as described in section 2.
*   Arrows will have clear, concise labels indicating the data or process flow.
*   The iterative loop in Phase 2 will be annotated as described in section 3.
*   A main title above the entire diagram will read: **"Overview of the PaperBanana Multi-Agent Framework"**.

**6. Input/Output:**

*   **Inputs:** "Methodology Section (S)", "Figure Caption (C)", "Reference Examples".
*   **Outputs:** "Final Illustration".

**7. Styling:**

*   **Background:** Pure white.
*   **Component Boxes:** Rounded rectangles with subtle shadows.
*   **Colors:**
    *   Phase 1 Background: Warm peach.
    *   Phase 2 Background: Soft sky blue.
    *   Text: Dark charcoal grey for readability.
    *   Icons: Subtle, muted tones (e.g., light grey, desaturated blue).
*   **Lines:**
    *   Arrows: Medium thickness, solid lines for primary flow.
    *   Iterative Feedback Arrow: Slightly thicker, dashed line.
    *   Group Borders: Thin, dashed lines.
*   **Icons:**
    *   "Curated Set of High-Quality Diagrams": A small stack of stylized documents.
    *   "Text-to-Image Generation Model": A cloud icon with a simple image silhouette inside.
    *   "Publication-Quality Academic Illustration": A stylized frame or a document icon with a star.
*   **Font:** A clean, sans-serif font (e.g., Arial, Helvetica) for all text. Font sizes will vary to emphasize hierarchy (title largest, component labels medium, arrow labels smaller).
